description: This file defines a Java class 'JakartaOptimisticLockExceptionMapper' that implements an exception mapper for handling 'OptimisticLockException' in a REST API context. It maps the exception to an HTTP 409 Conflict response with a standardized error response format.

classes.name: JakartaOptimisticLockExceptionMapper
classes.description: A REST exception mapper that handles 'OptimisticLockException' and converts it into a standardized API error response with HTTP 409 status.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts an 'OptimisticLockException' into a Response object with a conflict error payload.

methods.name: errorCode
methods.description: Returns an internal error code (4019) associated with this exception.
